title: Repealing the Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Act, No.2 of 1996 and introducing a new Act
decision_details: - Cabinet approval has been granted at its meeting held on 2024-12-30 to introduce a new Act repealing the Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Act, No.2 of 1996 and to appoint a committee to examine the initial draft prepared for the said purpose and submit an initial draft incorporating suitable amendments. Accordingly, the relevant Committee has prepared an amended draft with the appropriate amendments. The proposal made by the Minister of Fisheries, Aquatic and Ocean Resources to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare a new Bill, based on the said amended initial draft, was approved by the Cabinet.
